evidence.reason: The scan resolves a symlink with path.stat(), then silently skips any target that is not a regular file at lines 695-696. A symlink to a drop-in directory is therefore neither traversed nor recorded as an incomplete observation. Because systemd can read drop-ins through such a directory, the dependency can be missed while discovery still treats the scan as complete/supported. The no-follow policy can remain; the fix is to mark this case incomplete instead of silently continuing.
